lessons: A market proxy whose history changes between reads is a delayed proxy, not a proxy; every figure computed against it is provisional until its own past stops moving.
Removing a constraint tests a diagnosis better than examining it: three pages argued the outage was billing from log signatures, and one configuration change settled it in a day.
Volume without a price is evidence about the vendor, not the market; an instrument that traded and did not print was not quiet.
A filter placed at one seam does not clean the readers on the other side of it, and a page must say which count a number came from.
